title.narrative: Supporting Sustainable Tourism Development in Qena Governorate for Local Economic Development

description.narrative:
This joint project by UN-Habitat and UNDP aims to implement an integrated revitalization model for the historic Dendera area in Qena Governorate. Leveraging the cultural and natural assets of Dendera, the project addresses pressing challenges in infrastructure, community inclusion, and underdeveloped tourism services. The initiative seeks to use participatory approaches to preserve cultural heritage while promoting inclusive local economic development through sustainable tourism.
Approach: The project follows a participatory, multi-sectoral methodology anchored in four key outcomes: (1) Environmental upgrading for heritage and infrastructure, (2) Mapping and strengthening the tourism value chain, (3) Empowering local MSMEs, and (4) Cultural asset documentation and heritage management planning.
These components will be implemented with strong engagement from local stakeholders, national authorities, and the community.
Expected Accomplishments: By the end of the project, the Dendera area will have a clear development roadmap through an endorsed environmental upgrading plan, tourism value chain map, MSME integration strategy, and a validated cultural assets map, positioning it as a replicable model for sustainable cultural tourism in Upper Egypt.
